name: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪ Dolce Vita
original_name: うたの☆プリンスさまっ♪ Dolce Vita
source: A new story featuring the 11 idols of the Shining Agency. A "love simulation game" that explores Haruka's growth as a composer and her love story with the idol of the player's choosing.
translation: 以Shining事务所的11名偶像为主角的新故事。这是一款“恋爱模拟游戏”，描写遥作为作曲家的成长，以及她与玩家选择的偶像之间的恋爱故事。
